description: This file contains macro definitions and function implementations for managing slabs of commit data structures, including initialization, clearing, deep clearing, and access functions.

methods.name: init_ ##slabname## _with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab with a specified stride, setting size parameters.

methods.name: init_ ##slabname
methods.description: Initializes a slab with default stride of 1.

methods.name: deep_clear_ ##slabname
methods.description: Deep clears slabs using a provided free function for each element.

methods.name: slabname##_at_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit index, optionally adding if missing.

methods.name: slabname##_at
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit index, adding if missing.

methods.name: slabname##_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit index without adding if missing.
